title: Counting from zero
instructions: Each box in a list has a number, called its index. The first box is number 0, not 1!
scores[0] is the first box. In a list of 3, the boxes are 0, 1 and 2.
So the last box is scores[scores.size() - 1]. Asking for scores[3] in a list of 3 goes past the end: a classic bug.
task: Print the first and the last score, so the program prints:  First: 3 Last: 5  (each on its own line)
hint:
The last index is one less than the size:

    std::cout << "Last: " << scores[scores.size() - 1] << "\n";
